findings.assessment: Braking-box displacement 0.005559344630308817 m is travel from its own initial position, not the distance between the two input endpoints. Using it to describe a small inter-arm endpoint difference is unsupported.
The blanket description of motion as only 0.30-0.35 s omits measured 0.28 and 0.29 s endpoints returned by prediction queries.
Says neither rollout represents a held-input strategy although both hold their inputs fixed. It can correctly exclude a validated closed-loop strategy.
A lower endpoint speed under the tested alternative establishes a local alternative, not globally maximal endpoint braking. No equivalence or optimal endpoint bound was computed.
